notes: Stories created for Recruitment Status measure with full coverage (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

stories.title: Define Recruitment Status Score Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial recruitment status scoring including allowed statuses (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, UNKNOWN), score mapping, and response contract for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to assign scores based on trial recruitment status (e.g., RECRUITING = highest score, COMPLETED = medium, TERMINATED = lowest). Include handling for missing or ambiguous statuses.

stories.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into clinical trials output and expose via evaluate_care_facade so it is included in trial evaluation responses.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Recruitment Status Scoring
stories.description: Create unit tests validating score assignment across all recruitment statuses including edge cases (unknown, null, unexpected values).

stories.title: Integration Test for Recruitment Status in Trial Evaluation Flow
stories.description: Validate end-to-end integration ensuring recruitment status is fetched, scored, and returned correctly in clinical trial evaluation responses.

per_feature.mitigation: Use explicit status mapping with fallback to UNKNOWN to prevent scoring failure.

per_measure.mitigation: Default unknown or missing statuses to neutral score and label clearly in output.
